title: Chapter 406 Sister
content:
Chapter 406 Sister

From the standpoint of the human race, this is normal.

But in the eyes of this little demon, these people are like demons and should not live in this world.

At this moment, the little demon was like a lamb to be slaughtered in everyone's eyes, and it was easy to catch him.

But Xiao Yao did not surrender. Facing everyone, he did the opposite and took the initiative to attack, catching everyone off guard.

The little demon has a flexible method, flowing through the dense attacks of everyone, and flexibly avoiding it, but this place is a border and a territory of the human race.

The final outcome is that the little demon is outnumbered and is captured by the powerful human race.

"ah!!!"

The little demon, trapped by the human race's powerful moves, kept roaring, venting his resentment towards everyone.

Straws of white hair emerged from the surface of his body, and the power of the little demon gradually began to soar.

This is actually a white tiger, and it also has a rare bloodline of the Heavenly Demon. Although it is a bit thin, it is enough to shock the entire Heavenly Demon Clan.

If the senior officials of the Tiande Clan learned about this little demon, they would probably have to protect the little demon even if they were fighting to be hated by the human race.

Faced with the counterattack of the little demon, the powerful people of the human race hurriedly joined forces to suppress it.

"Damn, this little beast is so fierce."

"This is a white tiger, how much is this worth, hahahaha."

"I didn't expect that I would have the honor to taste the wine made by the White Tiger."

Even though the little demon is powerful, he is outnumbered after all.

As the little demon was deflated and lay on the ground, everyone completely captured the little white tiger demon.

Huh huh ~

The little demon lay on the ground and gasped, and a hint of despair gradually appeared in his eyes.

At this moment, his hatred for the human race reached its peak.

"I bought this little demon!"

At this moment, a man wearing a golden crown appeared in the field, waved his hand, and the confidence in his eyes was beyond words.

The powerful humans who worked together to capture the little demon couldn't help but frown slightly.

Everyone present was aware of the goods, and no one knew that this little demon was a treasure.

But at this moment, several powerful men dressed in unity appeared in the field and surrounded everyone. These powerful men were all deep in breath. Those who knew the eyes could see that these were border troops at a glance. Specially to guard the border.

However, due to the human power in recent years, the border troops have lost their significance and have become the minions of these local tyrants.

Obviously, this man is one of the local tyrants.

Although everyone who came here was extremely reluctant, they still made way.

The man with golden crown smiled evilly and then walked straight to the little demon.

At this moment, the little demon was exhausted and returned to his original white tiger appearance. He was very helpless when he lay on the ground.

But even so, he still had the oppression that the White Tiger should have, which was as tall as two people.

Looking at the little white tiger demon in front of him, the man with golden crown did not hide the excitement in his eyes.

If you can tame such a monster, your status will definitely rise.

"Now, recognize me as the master immediately."

"You should know what the price of disobeying me."

The man with golden crown sneered gloomy.

Hearing the man's words, the White Tiger Demon gasped for a moment and said coldly in a tender tone: "You're dreaming."

However, the man with golden crown was not surprised at all, but instead looked at the little demon playfully, "You are still very tough, but you met me."

As he said that, the man in Jinguan clapped his hands and said, "Take that guy up."

"yes."

A moment later, two human strong men came to the field with an iron cage.

A young girl trapped in the iron cage.

But everyone knew that this was a monster, and there were traces of the monster remaining on it, and the transformation was not perfect.

"younger sister!!"

When he saw the girl in the cage, the trapped little demon suddenly rose up, but was severely suppressed by the man with golden crown in front of him.

After all, how could those who can make a difference in the border areas be mediocre people?

"Now, can you accept me as yourselves?"

The man smiled, but his smile was very creepy.

The little demon's eyes were bloodshot and he stared at the golden crown man in front of him.

If his eyes could eat people, the man with golden crown would have been swallowed alive by him at this moment.

It was precisely because his sister was captured by the human race that he took the risk of sneaking into the border to save his sister, but unexpectedly, before he found her sister, he had already exposed his identity.

He is an orphan and has depended on his sister since he was a child. To him, his sister is his whole world.

But the human race deprived his sister of her freedom and made him lose the whole world.

Seeing that the little demon didn't say anything, the man sneered, "Come on, chop her into meat sauce!"

"No!!"

"Stop, I agree, I recognize you as the master, don't hurt my sister!"

"I beg you, I beg you, don't hurt my sister!"

The little demon knelt down at the golden crown man with a pounce, bursting into tears.

In the iron cage, it seemed that I could hear my brother's voice. The girl slowly opened her slightly dim eyes. When she saw her brother, she burst into tears, "Brother, you shouldn't have come."

The girl's voice was weak, but the little demon was trembling all over, "Sister, it's my brother who didn't protect you."

"Oh, I'm really touched."

The man in the golden-crowned house looked at the family affection between the two demons and couldn't help but sigh, "Don't worry, as long as you follow me and you will definitely be prosperous and prosperous for the rest of your life."

Hearing this, the little demon knocked his head to the ground, his eyes full of despair.

And just then, the soldiers on the border next to him suddenly shouted: "Sir, it's not good, this guy is going to commit suicide!"

"Um?!"

I saw that the girl's face was pale and blood was flowing.

Seeing this scene, the little demon roared in despair, and the man with golden crown also looked ugly, "Damn it!"

If this guy dies, then this little demon will never regard him as the main person. Then wouldn't he be in vain?

"Save her, save her quickly, sister, don't leave me!"

The little white tiger demon looked excited and struggled hard.

But he could clearly feel that his sister's aura was getting weaker and weaker. He knew that he might not have a sister.

Under the extreme grief, his bloodline of the Heavenly Demon finally began to awaken!

Buzz —

Suddenly, a powerful wave of air burst out from the White Tiger Demon's body, and instantly broke free from the shackles.

There was a bang.

The little white tiger demon knocked the unprepared golden crowned man away and rushed straight into the iron cage.

"Stop him!"

The golden-crowned man reacted and shouted.

The powerful men immediately took action, and complicated tricks kept bombarding the body of the White Tiger Demon.

At this moment, the little demon, whose size has become several times larger, seemed to have become a moving target and was bombarded by everyone in turn, but the little demon ignored it and slapped the iron cage with a broken hand, trying to break through the siege with the girl.

But gradually, as the movement here became more and more intense, many human powerhouses gathered here.

The man with golden crown knew that he could not monopolize the white tiger demon, so he immediately ordered, "Kill him and leave no living!"

In this way, the strong men no longer held back and their methods were even sharper.

Finally, the White Tiger Demon began to lose strength. Even though his combat power surged with the blessing of the Heavenly Demon bloodline, it was ultimately impossible for four palms to defeat the punches.

At the last moment, Baihu's consciousness gradually became blurred, and he could only protect his sister in his arms with his strong belief.
